  FEUDAL JAPAN PROPS Vol.1
  by PixelKensei Archive  |  https://pixelkensei.itch.io
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

8 top-down pixel art props for RPG, adventure, and
dungeon-crawler style games.

Part of the Feudal Japan series:
  Vol.1 — Props & Objects       ← YOU ARE HERE
  Vol.2 — Structures & Architecture
  Vol.3 — Nature & Terrain
  Bundle — Complete Pack        (paid, all 3 vols)

── CONTENTS ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  PNG/
    01_torii_gate_32x32.png
    02_stone_lantern_32x32.png
    03_bamboo_cluster_32x32.png
    04_sake_barrel_32x32.png
    05_katana_stand_32x32.png
    06_paper_lantern_32x32.png
    07_wooden_fence_32x32.png
    08_offering_box_32x32.png

  spritesheet/
    feudal_japan_props_spritesheet.png      ← 4x2 grid, 2px gap
    feudal_japan_props_spritesheet_4x.png   ← preview (4x upscale)

  palette/
    feudal_japan_palette.gpl   ← import into Aseprite / GIMP

  source_info/
    HOW_TO_IMPORT_ASEPRITE.txt

── SPECS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Size        : 32 x 32 px per asset
  Perspective : Top-down (bird's eye view)
  Format      : PNG with transparent background (RGBA)
  Palette     : 81 colors
  Spritesheet : 138 x 70 px (4 cols x 2 rows, 2px gap)

── COMPATIBILITY ─────────────────────────────────────────

  ✓  RPG Maker MZ / MV / XP
  ✓  Godot Engine
  ✓  Unity (2D)
  ✓  GameMaker Studio 2
  ✓  LDtk / Tiled (map editors)
  ✓  Any engine that supports PNG sprites
